data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 SHARES MECHANISM with the error SRC_003 documents: both attempt the constant-difference shortcut (assuming a single residue c with x≡c mod lcm applies), and both are refuted by the same observation — the differences 3-5=-2 and 4-7=-3 are unequal, so the CRT collapse to x≡c mod 35 is invalid. Refuted if -2≡-3 mod 5 or mod 7 (they differ, confirming the shared mechanism fails identically in both artifacts).
